source_documents.title: A Computational Protocol to Predict Anti-Kasha Emissions: The Case of Azulene Derivatives

reference_evidence_units.subject: 1b / guaiazulene
reference_evidence_units.statement: The paper identifies 1b as guaiazulene, distinct from parent 1a and halogenated 1c-d.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Designation only; candidate graph remains unverified.

reference_evidence_units.subject: 1b
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1; ADC(2) values in parentheses, compared with experimental 0-0 transitions in 3-methylpentane.
reference_evidence_units.statement: ADC(2) S1/S2 0-0 energies are 1.68/3.45 eV versus cited experiment 1.64/3.34 eV; corresponding vertical oscillator strengths are 0.015/0.040.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not confuse vertical energy, 0-0 energy or oscillator strength; experiment is reused literature.

reference_evidence_units.subject: 1b
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F052 TVCF model at 298 K; gas-phase PBE0/6-31G(d) geometries/frequencies and ADC(2)/def2-TZVP energies/dipoles. Table 2 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Computed S1 kr=1.2 x10^6, kIC=6.7 x10^11 s^-1; S2 kr=1.7 x10^7, kIC to S1=5.5 x10^9 s^-1. Predicted S2 PLQY is 0.31%, S1 PLQY 1.8 x10^-4%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not measured values. Harmonic-model and excited-state-coupling approximations apply.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Experimental data are averaged values from ref. 33 (b), ref. 34 (c) and ref. 81 (d), respectively.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1b, Table 2 experimental column
reference_evidence_units.conditions: External experimental values compiled in F052; Table 2 visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Compiled 1b S2 yield is 1.5 +/-0.1%, kr=3.2 +/-0.4 x10^7 s^-1 and nonradiative rate 2.1 +/-0.1 x10^9 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Computed 0.31% substantially underestimates 1.5%; do not describe agreement as exact. Original experiments not personally inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: for 1b, HT effects are definitely less important.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1b
reference_evidence_units.conditions: FC versus FC+HT spectra; main account of SI Figure S5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors find similar spectra with/without HT for 1b, unlike parent 1a and 1c; larger S2 oscillator strength makes HT less important.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI spectra not inspected; retain the explicitly differential series result.

reference_evidence_units.quote: for 1b, 1c and 1d, the presence of heavy-atom substituents at the 1,3 positions blocks this low frequency accepting mode
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1b, 1c and 1d
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors describe reduced contribution of an approximately 850 cm^-1 accepting mode; 1b is also the exception to the common approximately 1450 cm^-1 dominant mode. Total reorganization energy and IC remain higher than in 1a.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Preserve the source's loose 'heavy-atom substituents' wording as interpretation; this does not mean 1b is halogenated. No general emission enhancement or aggregation RIV established.

reference_evidence_units.quote: for azulene derivatives, intersystem crossing processes among other possible non-radiative decay pathways are not relevant.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1a-1e, including 1b
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Model pathway selection based on earlier experimental literature.
reference_evidence_units.statement: ISC is neglected and singlet radiative/internal-conversion channels dominate the model.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Model assumption grounded in cited work, not a newly measured zero ISC; heavy atoms do not automatically justify a triplet label.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the fluorescence yield from S2 is at least 1500 times larger than the yield from S1.
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1a-1e, including 1b
reference_evidence_units.conditions: F052 TVCF model at 298 K; gas-phase PBE0/6-31G(d) geometries/frequencies and ADC(2)/def2-TZVP energies/dipoles.
reference_evidence_units.statement: All studied derivatives are predicted to have appreciable S2 but negligible S1 fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Comparative prediction, not equality of individual rates/yields. S1 emission is extremely small, not mathematically zero.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Individual rates, transition strengths and vibronic coupling account for low S1 yield and much stronger S2 emission; imperfect quantitative agreement remains explicit.

reference_mechanisms.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source predicts non-thermally-equilibrated S2 anti-Kasha emission for 1b and compares to external measurements.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: One accepting mode is blocked by substitution in the source analysis, but total reorganization energy/IC are increased and there is no tested restriction-driven enhancement. Do not map all vibronic calculations to RIM.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific external packing or matrix confinement mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific binding of a guest, solvent or analyte that alters emission established.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific charge-transfer excited-state mechanism established in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer pathway established; hydrogen bonding or an OH substituent alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on established; CT-state character is not by itself a separate PET process.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex emission established; aggregation alone does not establish this family.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Individual rates, transition strengths and vibronic coupling account for low S1 yield and much stronger S2 emission; imperfect quantitative agreement remains explicit.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: ISC is neglected in the singlet kinetic model; no positive triplet evidence, and absence is not independently proven.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No conical-intersection-mediated nonradiative pathway established for this target in the extracted evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source predicts non-thermally-equilibrated S2 anti-Kasha emission for 1b and compares to external measurements.
